name: Lindy
tagline: An AI executive assistant you text over iMessage or SMS, built on a no-code agent platform still available underneath.
verdict: Lindy has moved from selling itself as a no-code "AI employee" builder to selling a finished AI executive assistant you text over iMessage or SMS, connect your phone and inbox, and it starts triaging email, prepping meetings and chasing follow-ups without you opening an app. That text-first interface is genuinely the fastest on-ramp to a useful agent in this category, and human-in-the-loop review keeps you in control. The old no-code agent builder hasn’t gone away, it still exists under an "App Builder" product for teams who want to construct custom multi-agent flows, but it is no longer what Lindy leads with, so buyers who want that specifically have to go looking for it. The other real catch is cost transparency: usage is metered in credits, stronger models burn more, and once a plan’s monthly allotment is gone, overage work is billed at 2x the standard rate. It’s also cloud-only, closed-source, and has no permanent free plan, just a 7-day trial. Pick Lindy if you want a working AI assistant you can text starting today and will watch your credit usage; skip it if you need self-hosting, an open API to build on, or flat, predictable pricing.
